name: Full Metal Racket (VST3)
description: An analogue drum machine whose twelve voices share a power rail, a shell and a bleed web — so a hard kick dips the whole machine in pitch as well as level, and hitting the snare rings the toms. A thirty-two step sequencer with a last step per lane, so polyrhythms cost one number. Two hundred generated kits and a fader that morphs between any two.
note: Windows VST3 · build 260827.22 · free download · 13-page manual included.
